IErpHrmTimesheet.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
Search, filter, and pagination parameters for the timesheet listing endpoint (PATCH /erpHrm/member/timesheets).

This is a request body DTO — it does not map to any single database table. Each property translates to a WHERE, ORDER BY, or pagination clause in the query against erp_hrm_timesheets.

**Authorization Scoping**: The query automatically scopes to the current organization context. Additionally:
- Users with `time:view_all` or time approval permission see all non-deleted timesheets in the organization.
- Regular employees see only their own timesheets (WHERE employee_id = requesting employee's record).
- Exclude soft-deleted timesheets (deleted_at IS NOT NULL).

**Filter Mapping**:
- status: WHERE status IN (values) — filter by one or more workflow states.
- dateRange: WHERE week_start_date <= dateRange.end AND week_end_date >= dateRange.start — overlap filter returning any timesheet whose calendar week intersects the requested range.
- employeeId: WHERE employee_id = value — only honored when caller has time:view_all or time approval permission; otherwise rejected for cross-employee queries.

**Pagination**:
- page: OFFSET-based pagination, 1-indexed. Calculated as (page - 1) * limit.
- limit: Clamped to 1–100 range. Defaults to server-defined value when omitted.
- sort: ORDER BY clause. Must be SQL-safe — only allow known column names (id, week_start_date, status, submitted_at, created_at) with ASC/DESC direction. Defaults to created_at DESC.

status.description:
Filter invitations by their current lifecycle status.

When specified, only invitations matching the given status are returned. When omitted, invitations of all statuses are included.

- **pending**: The invitation has been sent and is awaiting the recipient's sign-up.
- **fulfilled**: The invitation was accepted and resolved into an employee record.
- **revoked**: The invitation was manually cancelled before acceptance.
status.x-autobe-specification: Optional filter on invitation lifecycle status. When provided, restricts results to invitations matching the specified status. Valid values: 'pending' (awaiting recipient sign-up), 'fulfilled' (accepted and resolved), 'revoked' (manually cancelled). When omitted, returns invitations regardless of status. Validated via regex pattern.

email.description:
Search invitations by the recipient's email address.

Performs a case-insensitive partial match — entering "john" will return invitations sent to "john@example.com", "john.doe@company.org", and similar addresses. When omitted, no email-based filtering occurs.
email.x-autobe-specification: Optional case-insensitive partial substring match against the invited email address. Performs SQL ILIKE '%value%' or equivalent. When omitted, no email filter is applied.

page.description:
The page number to retrieve.

Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page is page 1. When omitted, the first page is returned by default. Used together with limit to control which slice of results is returned.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-based page number for offset-based pagination. Minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1 when not provided. Combined with limit to calculate the SQL OFFSET: (page - 1) * limit.

limit.description:
The maximum number of invitation records to return per page.

Must be between 1 and 100. When omitted, a system default value is used. The actual number of records returned may be less than this value on the final page or when total results are fewer than the requested limit.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Maximum number of records per page. Bounded between 1 and 100 inclusive. Defaults to a system-configured value (e.g., 20) when not provided. Used as the SQL LIMIT clause value.

IErpHrmInvitation.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and pagination criteria for browsing organization invitations.

Provides optional filters to narrow results by invitation status and recipient email, along with standard pagination controls. All parameters are optional — callers can retrieve a complete unfiltered list with default pagination, or apply specific criteria to find targeted invitation records.
IErpHrmInvitation.IRequest.x-autobe-specification:
Query filter and pagination parameters for the invitation list endpoint (PATCH /erpHrm/member/invitations). All parameters are optional — omitting all returns a complete paginated list sorted by created_at descending.

status: When provided, filters invitations by their lifecycle status. Valid values are 'pending' (awaiting recipient sign-up), 'fulfilled' (resolved after acceptance), and 'revoked' (manually cancelled). When omitted, invitations of all statuses are returned.

email: When provided, performs a case-insensitive partial substring match (SQL ILIKE '%value%') against the invited email address field. When omitted, no email filter is applied.

page: 1-based page number for offset-based pagination. Defaults to 1 when not provided.
limit: Number of records per page, bounded between 1 and 100. Defaults to a system-configured value (e.g., 20) when not provided.

No sort parameter — results are always sorted by invitation creation timestamp in descending order (most recent first). Organization scoping is handled by the session context, not by request parameters.

rejection_reason.description:
Explanation of why the timesheet was rejected.

Must be a non-empty string providing clear and actionable context to the employee about what needs to be revised before resubmission. The rejection reason is stored on the timesheet record and remains visible to the employee and reviewers for audit purposes.

A meaningful rejection reason helps the employee understand exactly what corrections are needed — for example, indicating which timelogs need adjustment or what information is missing — reducing the number of revision cycles.
rejection_reason.x-autobe-specification: Maps to erp_hrm_timesheets.rejection_reason column. The database column is nullable (String?) but this action enforces mandatory non-empty input with minLength 1. Server validates the value is present and non-blank — returns 422 Unprocessable Entity if missing, null, or whitespace-only. Written to erp_hrm_timesheets.rejection_reason when the timesheet transitions from 'submitted' to 'draft' status during the reject operation. Other server-managed fields set simultaneously: reviewed_by_user_id (from JWT), reviewed_at (current timestamp), status (to 'draft'), updated_at (current timestamp).

IErpHrmTimesheet.IReject.description:
Rejection payload for returning a submitted timesheet to draft status.

Contains the mandatory reason explaining why the timesheet was rejected, providing the employee with clear context for necessary revisions before resubmission. This payload is used exclusively by managers and organization owners who hold the time:approve permission.

After rejection, the timesheet transitions from submitted back to draft status. All timelogs within the timesheet remain unchanged and editable, allowing the employee to make corrections and resubmit. The rejection reason is stored on the timesheet record and is visible to the employee when viewing the rejected timesheet.
IErpHrmTimesheet.IReject.x-autobe-specification: Action DTO for POST /erpHrm/member/timesheets/{timesheetId}/reject. Only rejection_reason is sourced from the request body — it maps to erp_hrm_timesheets.rejection_reason (String? in the database schema, but mandatory and non-empty per business rule for this action). Server-managed fields set during the reject operation: reviewed_by_user_id resolved from the authenticated user's JWT, reviewed_at auto-set to the current timestamp, status set to 'draft', updated_at auto-set to the current timestamp. The timesheetId is provided as a URL path parameter. All other erp_hrm_timesheets columns and relations are read-only, server-managed, or not applicable in this request-body context.

erp_hrm_role_id.description:
Unique identifier of the target role to assign to the employee.

Must reference a role that exists within the same organization as the employee and is not soft-deleted. Both built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles may be assigned. The new permissions take effect immediately upon successful role change.
erp_hrm_role_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_role_id. The backend looks up the target role in erp_hrm_roles, validates it belongs to the same organization (erp_hrm_organization_id matches the employee's), and is not soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL). On success, the employee's erp_hrm_role_id is updated and updated_at is set to the current timestamp. An activity log entry is inserted recording the role change.

IErpHrmEmployee.IUpdateRole.description:
Request body for changing an employee's role assignment.

Contains the unique identifier of the target role to assign to the employee. The role must exist within the same organization as the employee and must not be soft-deleted. The new role assignment takes effect immediately, and the change is recorded in the activity log with the previous and new role identifiers.

Any available role within the organization may be assigned, including both built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles. There is no restriction on how many employees may hold the same role, including the Owner role.
IErpHrmEmployee.IUpdateRole.x-autobe-specification: Maps: erp_hrm_role_id. Sets the new role assignment on the erp_hrm_employees record identified by the path parameter employeeId. The backend validates that the target role exists in erp_hrm_roles, belongs to the same organization (erp_hrm_organization_id matches), and is not soft-deleted (deleted_at IS NULL). Updates updated_at to current timestamp on success. Inserts an activity log entry into erp_hrm_activity_logs with action_type 'role_changed', target_entity 'employee', and details containing previous_role_id and new_role_id. Excluded: employeeId (path parameter), erp_hrm_member_id / member (actor identity from JWT), erp_hrm_organization_id (organization context from session), all other employee fields (role-specific operation), timestamps (auto-managed by backend on update), all HAS-MANY/HAS-ONE relations (not request body fields).

data.description:
The collection of aggregated report entries, each discriminated by its grouping dimension.

When grouped by employee, each entry includes the employee's name alongside hour totals. When grouped by project, the project name appears with aggregated metrics. When grouped by task, task titles are included — timelogs without a task assignment are consolidated under an "Unassigned" entry.

An empty array indicates no timelogs matched the query filters for the specified date range. This is a valid response and does not indicate an error.
data.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregated results array computed from erp_hrm_timelogs query, discriminated by group_by field.

**Discriminator**: `group_by` — determines which variant schema each array element conforms to:
- `employee` → IErpHrmTimeReport.IEmployeeGroup (grouped by employee_id with display_name)
- `project` → IErpHrmTimeReport.IProjectGroup (grouped by project_id with project name)
- `task` → IErpHrmTimeReport.ITaskGroup (grouped by task_id with task title; null task_id entries appear as 'Unassigned')
- `grand_total` → IErpHrmTimeReport.IGrandTotal (single organization-wide summary when no groupBy specified)

Each variant contains the same core metrics (total_hours, billable_hours, non_billable_hours, entry_count) plus variant-specific identifier fields. The array may be empty when no timelogs match the query criteria — a 404 must NOT be returned.

IErpHrmTimeReport.description:
An aggregated time report summarizing logged work hours across the organization for a specified date range.

Results are grouped by the chosen dimension — employee, project, or task — with separate tallies for billable and non-billable hours alongside entry counts. When no grouping is specified, a single organization-wide grand total is returned.

All hour values are computed from aggregated duration data rounded to two decimal places. Individual timelog details such as personal notes and descriptions are not included in this report, ensuring privacy compliance while providing actionable workforce and project insights.
IErpHrmTimeReport.x-autobe-specification:
Computed report from erp_hrm_timelogs aggregated by the groupBy query parameter, scoped to the member's active organization context via session.

**Data Source**: erp_hrm_timelogs table, with JOINs:
- erp_hrm_employees (via employee_id) for employee display_name
- erp_hrm_projects (via project_id) for project name
- erp_hrm_tasks (via task_id) for task title

**Aggregation Formulas**:
- total_hours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60
- billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable = true) / 60
- non_billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable = false) / 60
- entry_count = COUNT(*)

**Grouping Behavior**:
- groupBy = 'employee': groups by employee_id, includes employee name via JOIN
- groupBy = 'project': groups by project_id, includes project name via JOIN
- groupBy = 'task': groups by task_id, includes task title via JOIN; timelogs with null task_id consolidated under synthetic entry with taskId: null and title: 'Unassigned'
- groupBy omitted: single grand_total entry for the entire organization

**Edge Cases**:
- No matching timelogs: return data: [] (empty array, not 404)
- Task grouping: null task_id entries appear as 'Unassigned' category
- dateFrom after dateTo: reject with 400 before query execution

**Authorization**: Requires report:view permission. employeeId filter additionally requires time:view_all or time:manage permission. Reject with 403 if unauthorized.

**Privacy**: Individual timelog descriptions and personal notes are never included in the response; only aggregated numerical data and group identifiers are exposed.

active_employee_count.description:
The total number of currently active employees in the organization.

Counts all employee records within the currently selected organization whose status is active and who have not been soft-deleted. This metric provides an at-a-glance workforce size indicator for managers and owners.
active_employee_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT of erp_hrm_employees where status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND erp_hrm_organization_id matches the session-selected organization context. If no active employees exist, return 0 — never null.

total_hours_this_week.description:
The total work hours logged across the entire organization for the current calendar week (Monday–Sunday).

Aggregates all timelog durations — both billable and non-billable — converted from minutes to hours with two-decimal precision. The current week is determined using the organization's configured timezone. A value of zero indicates no time has been logged this week yet.
total_hours_this_week.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where date falls within the current Monday–Sunday week (computed server-side using the organization's configured timezone), deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs, and the owning employee's erp_hrm_organization_id matches session context (enforced via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees). Round to 2 decimal places. If no timelogs exist for the week, return 0 — never null.

pending_timesheets_count.description:
The number of timesheets currently submitted and awaiting approval within the organization.

Counts all submitted timesheets that have not yet been approved or rejected. This metric helps managers prioritize their review workload.
pending_timesheets_count.x-autobe-specification: COUNT of erp_hrm_timesheets where status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL, joined through erp_hrm_employees to verify organization scope (erp_hrm_organization_id matches session context). If no pending timesheets exist, return 0 — never null.

projects_over_budget.description:
Projects whose actual logged hours exceed 80% of their budgeted hours.

Compares each project's planned budget against actual time logged through timelogs. Only projects with a defined budget are evaluated. Projects are ordered by utilization percentage, highest first. An empty array indicates no projects are approaching or exceeding their budget.
projects_over_budget.x-autobe-specification: For each project with a non-null budget_hours in erp_hrm_projects, calculate total minutes logged via erp_hrm_timelogs (excluding soft-deleted entries, scoped to session organization via JOIN through erp_hrm_employees). Compute utilization as (total_logged_minutes / 60) / budget_hours. Return projects where utilization > 0.80. Each item includes project_id (UUID), project_name (string), budget_hours (number), and actual_hours (number). Order by utilization descending. If no projects exceed 80% budget, return empty array — never null.

top_employees.description:
The top five employees ranked by total hours logged during the current calendar week.

Ranks active employees by their aggregated work hours for the current Monday-through-Sunday week, descending from most to least hours. Each entry identifies the employee by UUID and display name, along with their total hours with two-decimal precision. An empty array indicates no time has been logged this week.
top_employees.x-autobe-specification: Aggregate SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) per employee for the current Monday–Sunday week, JOIN erp_hrm_employees (filter: erp_hrm_organization_id matches session context, deleted_at IS NULL), JOIN erp_hrm_members for display_name. Exclude soft-deleted timelogs. GROUP BY employee_id, ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5. Each item includes employee_id (UUID), display_name (string), and total_hours (number, minutes/60 rounded to 2 decimals, ≥ 0). If no timelogs exist for the week, return empty array — never null.

IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.description:
A top employee ranked by total hours logged during the current calendar week.

Represents one of the five employees with the highest aggregated work hours for the week within the currently selected organization. The total hours reflect the sum of all billable and non-billable timelog durations, converted from minutes to hours with two-decimal precision. This entry is part of the organization dashboard's top-employees metric, surfaced to managers and owners who hold the report:view permission.
IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregated computation spanning three tables within the current organization context. Each row represents one of the top 5 employees ranked by total hours logged during the current calendar week (Monday–Sunday).

1. **employee_id**: Direct read from erp_hrm_employees.id. Filtered: erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id matches session-selected organization, deleted_at IS NULL.

2. **display_name**: JOIN erp_hrm_members ON erp_hrm_employees.member_id = erp_hrm_members.id, selecting erp_hrm_members.display_name. Both tables filtered for deleted_at IS NULL, organization scope via employee.

3. **total_hours**: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where date falls within the current Monday–Sunday week (computed server-side using the organization's configured timezone), deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs, and the owning employee matches organization scope via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees. Round to 2 decimal places.

Overall: GROUP BY employee_id, ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5. If no timelogs exist for the week, return empty array — never null fields. Each row must satisfy: employee_id is non-null UUID, display_name is non-null string, total_hours is non-null number ≥ 0.

email.description:
The email address of the person to invite as an employee.

Must be a valid email format. Only one pending invitation per email address can exist within an organization at a time. If the invited email already belongs to an active employee in the organization, the request is rejected with a conflict error.
email.x-autobe-specification:
The email address of the person being invited. Validated for RFC 5322 email format. Used for duplicate detection: checked against existing pending invitations in the current organization (409 if duplicate), and against active employee emails (409 if already a member). Also used for invitation email delivery (fire-and-forget).

Organization context is implicit from the active session.

role_id.description:
The role to assign to the invited employee upon joining the organization.

References an existing role within the current organization. Built-in roles (Owner, Manager, Employee) and custom roles are both accepted. The role determines the permissions the employee will have after accepting the invitation.
role_id.x-autobe-specification:
UUID referencing the role (erp_hrm_roles.id) the invitee will be assigned upon invitation fulfillment. Must exist and belong to the current organization context. Validated at invitation creation time to prevent dangling references.

When the invitation is resolved (recipient signs up with matching email), this role_id is used to create the employee record with the appropriate role assignment.

IErpHrmInvitation.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating an employee invitation.

Contains the email address of the person to invite and the role they will be assigned upon joining the organization. The invitation remains pending until the recipient signs up with the matching email address, at which point they are automatically added as an employee.

Only one pending invitation per email address can exist within an organization at a time. If the invited email already belongs to an active employee in the organization, the request is rejected with a conflict error.
IErpHrmInvitation.ICreate.x-autobe-specification:
This is a request-only DTO for invitation creation. It does not map to a single database table; the invitation record is built by combining the email and role_id from this DTO with the organization_id from the JWT session context, and a status of 'pending' is auto-assigned with the sent_at timestamp.

Validation: email must be valid format. Duplicate pending invitation for same email+org is rejected with 409. Existing active employee email is rejected with 409.

The role_id references erp_hrm_roles.id and determines the role the invitee receives upon fulfillment. Must be validated to exist within the current organization context.

hours_today_minutes.description:
Total minutes logged by the employee today.

Aggregates all timelog entries recorded on the current calendar date within the organization's timezone. Used to display daily time tracking progress. Returns zero when no time has been logged today.
hours_today_minutes.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current authenticated employee AND date = today's date in the organization's timezone. Respects deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for today.

hours_today_decimal_hours.description:
Total hours logged by the employee today, expressed as a decimal.

Calculated by dividing today's total minutes by 60. Provides a human-readable hours representation for dashboard display alongside the precise minute count. Returns zero when no time has been logged today.
hours_today_decimal_hours.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hours_today_minutes / 60.0. Uses the same underlying query: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND date = today. Returns 0.0 when no timelogs exist for today.

hours_this_week_minutes.description:
Total minutes logged by the employee during the current calendar week.

Aggregates all timelog entries from Monday through Sunday of the current week based on the organization's timezone. Used to track weekly time tracking progress. Returns zero when no time has been logged this week.
hours_this_week_minutes.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current authenticated employee AND date BETWEEN Monday 00:00 and Sunday 23:59 of the current calendar week (determined from the organization's timezone). Respects deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs. Returns 0 when no timelogs exist for the current week.

hours_this_week_decimal_hours.description:
Total hours logged by the employee during the current calendar week, expressed as a decimal.

Calculated by dividing this week's total minutes by 60. Provides a human-readable hours representation for dashboard display alongside the precise minute count. Returns zero when no time has been logged this week.
hours_this_week_decimal_hours.x-autobe-specification: Derived from hours_this_week_minutes / 60.0. Uses the same underlying query: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND date BETWEEN Monday 00:00 AND Sunday 23:59 of current calendar week. Returns 0.0 when no timelogs exist for the current week.

active_timer.description:
The employee's currently running timer, or null if no timer is active.

Represents a live time tracking session. An employee may have at most one active timer at any given time. When present, displays the project, optional task, description, and elapsed time since the timer was started. The elapsed time is computed as the difference between the current server time and the timer's start timestamp. Returns null when the employee has no running timer.
active_timer.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_timers WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = current employee. At most one record due to @@unique constraint on erp_hrm_employee_id. When a timer exists, return the full IErpHrmTimer object with timer fields plus a computed elapsed_seconds = (NOW() - start_timestamp) as an integer. The downstream Realize agent MUST include this computed elapsed_seconds field in the timer response for dashboard context. When no active timer exists, return null.

recent_timelogs.description:
The five most recent timelog entries for the employee, ordered by creation time descending.

Provides a quick-access list of the employee's latest time tracking activity for dashboard display. Each entry includes the work date, duration, associated project and optional task, description, and billable status. When the timelog is part of a timesheet, the timesheet's status is included. Returns an empty array when no timelogs exist.
recent_timelogs.x-autobe-specification: SELECT the 5 most recent erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current employee AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5. Each entry resolves to IErpHrmTimelog.ISummary including: id, date, duration_minutes, project (id + name via JOIN to erp_hrm_projects), task (id + title via JOIN to erp_hrm_tasks if task_id is set), description, billable. If timesheet_id is set, JOIN erp_hrm_timesheets for status display. Returns an empty array when the employee has no timelogs.

pending_timesheet.description:
The timesheet for the current calendar week, or null if none has been created yet.

Represents the employee's weekly timesheet that groups timelogs for the Monday-to-Sunday period. Shows the timesheet's workflow status — draft, submitted, approved, or rejected — along with the week boundaries. When the timesheet has been rejected, includes the reviewer's rejection reason to guide the employee's revision. Returns null when no timesheet exists for the current week.
pending_timesheet.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE employee_id = current employee AND week_start_date = Monday of the current calendar week (organization timezone). When found, return IErpHrmTimesheet.ISummary including: id, status, week_start_date, week_end_date. When status is 'rejected', include rejection_reason for display. When no timesheet exists for the current week, return null.

assigned_tasks.description:
Tasks assigned to the employee that are currently open or in progress.

Lists the employee's active workload for triage on the dashboard. Tasks are ordered by priority level — urgent tasks appear first, followed by high, medium, and low priority — with secondary ordering by due date so that the most time-sensitive items are immediately visible. Each entry includes the task title, status, priority, due date, estimated hours, and the parent project's name. Returns an empty array when the employee has no open or in-progress assigned tasks.
assigned_tasks.x-autobe-specification: Query erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_assigned_employee_id = current employee AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL. JOIN erp_hrm_projects for project id and name. ORDER BY priority (urgent first, then high, medium, low), due_date ASC with NULLS LAST. Each entry resolves to IErpHrmTask.ISummary including: id, title, status, priority, due_date, project (id + name), estimated_hours. Archived and completed projects with active tasks assigned to the employee should still appear. Returns an empty array when no open or in-progress tasks are assigned.

IErpHrmPersonalDashboard.description:
Aggregated personal dashboard for the authenticated employee, providing an at-a-glance summary of their current work status.

The dashboard combines time tracking progress (hours logged today and this week), active timer status, the five most recent time entries, the current week's timesheet, and open or in-progress assigned tasks into a single unified response. Designed for rendering a personal home screen where the employee can immediately see their daily and weekly progress, manage their active timer, review recent work, monitor timesheet submission status, and triage open tasks.

All data is strictly scoped to the authenticated employee within the currently selected organization. Each section is independently computed — if any section has no data, its fields gracefully default to zero, an empty array, or null rather than causing the entire request to fail. The employee must be active to access this endpoint; a deactivated employee receives a 403 response.
IErpHrmPersonalDashboard.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation from multiple source tables scoped to the authenticated employee's organization context. No direct table mapping.

Source queries (all scoped to current employee, respecting deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs, timesheets, tasks, projects):

1. hours_today_minutes / hours_today_decimal_hours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND date = today (organization timezone). decimal_hours = minutes / 60.0.

2. hours_this_week_minutes / hours_this_week_decimal_hours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND date BETWEEN Monday 00:00 AND Sunday 23:59 of current calendar week (organization timezone). decimal_hours = minutes / 60.0.

3. active_timer: erp_hrm_timers WHERE erp_hrm_employee_id = current (at most one due to @@unique constraint). IMPORTANT: The downstream Realize agent MUST include computed elapsed_seconds = (NOW() - start_timestamp) as an integer in the timer response for this dashboard context. If no timer exists, return null. Additional fields required: id, start_timestamp, project (id + name via JOIN to erp_hrm_projects), task (id + title via JOIN to erp_hrm_tasks if task_id set), description.

4. recent_timelogs: 5 most recent erp_hrm_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current AND deleted_at IS NULL, ORDER BY created_at DESC. Include: id, date, duration_minutes, project (id + name), task (id + title), description, billable. If timesheet_id is set, JOIN erp_hrm_timesheets for status.

5. pending_timesheet: erp_hrm_timesheets WHERE employee_id = current AND week_start_date = Monday of current week. Include: id, status, week_start_date, week_end_date. If status is rejected, include rejection_reason. If no timesheet exists for current week, return null.

6. assigned_tasks: erp_hrm_tasks WHERE erp_hrm_assigned_employee_id = current AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') AND deleted_at IS NULL. JOIN erp_hrm_projects for project name. ORDER BY priority (urgent > high > medium > low), due_date ASC NULLS LAST. Include: id, title, status, priority, due_date, project (id + name), estimated_hours.

Graceful defaults when no data: hours fields → 0, arrays → [], nullable objects → null. Employee must be active (status = 'active') — return 403 if deactivated.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the invitation.

A system-generated UUID assigned when the invitation record is created. Used to reference the invitation in subsequent operations such as revocation or status checks.
id.x-autobe-specification: System-generated UUID v4 assigned at invitation creation time. Not derived from any database column.

email.description:
The email address of the invited person.

The invitation is delivered to this email address. The recipient must sign up using the same email for the invitation to be automatically resolved. Only one pending invitation per email address can exist within an organization at any time.
email.x-autobe-specification: The email address the invitation was sent to. Must be unique among pending invitations within the same organization. Validated as a properly formatted email address. Used for matching when the recipient signs up.

status.description:
Current status of the invitation.

**pending**: The invitation has been sent but the recipient has not yet signed up with the matching email address. The invitation remains in this state indefinitely until fulfilled, revoked, or the organization is deleted.

**resolved**: The recipient has signed up with the matching email and has been automatically added as an employee of the organization with the assigned role.
status.x-autobe-specification: Enum discriminator with two possible values: 'pending' or 'resolved'. Set to 'pending' at invitation creation time. Transitions to 'resolved' when the recipient successfully signs up with the matching email address. No other valid transitions exist.

role.description:
The role assigned to the invitee upon joining the organization.

Determines the complete set of permissions the new employee will have once the invitation is resolved. The role is selected at invitation creation time and cannot be changed after the invitation is sent. Use the employee role change operation if a different role is needed after the employee joins.
role.x-autobe-specification: Resolved from the stored role_id by joining to erp_hrm_roles. Returns the ISummary of the role the invitee will receive upon joining. Includes id, name, is_builtin, description, permissions_count, created_at, and updated_at.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the invitation was sent.

Represents the exact moment the invitation record was created and the invitation email was dispatched to the recipient. This timestamp is immutable and provides an audit trail of when the invitation process began.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Timestamp recorded at the moment the invitation is created and the email is dispatched. Captured as server time at record creation. Immutable after creation.

resolved_at.description:
Timestamp when the invitation was resolved.

Null when the invitation is still in pending status. Set to the exact moment the recipient successfully signs up with the matching email address, at which point the invitation is fulfilled and the user is automatically added as an employee of the organization with the assigned role.
resolved_at.x-autobe-specification: Null when the invitation status is 'pending'. Set to the server timestamp at the moment the recipient signs up with the matching email address and the invitation transitions to 'resolved'. Immutable once set.

IErpHrmInvitation.description:
An employee invitation record for joining an organization.

Represents an invitation sent to an email address, inviting that person to join the current organization as an employee. The invitation carries an assigned role that determines the invitee's permissions upon joining.

**Status Lifecycle**: The invitation starts as pending when sent. It transitions to resolved when the recipient signs up with the matching email address, at which point they automatically become an employee with the assigned role.

**Multi-organization**: The same email address can have pending invitations in different organizations simultaneously. Each invitation is scoped to a single organization.
IErpHrmInvitation.x-autobe-specification: Application-layer invitation records with no direct database table mapping. The invitation is constructed by combining the email and role_id from IErpHrmInvitation.ICreate with an organization context from the active member session. The ID is a system-generated UUID v4. Status defaults to 'pending' at creation and transitions to 'resolved' when the recipient signs up with the matching email address, at which point they are automatically added as an employee with the assigned role. The role field is resolved by joining role_id to erp_hrm_roles and returning ISummary. Organization context is implicit from the active session and never exposed in the DTO.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the invitation.

Assigned automatically when the invitation is created and never modified.
id.x-autobe-specification: Primary key of the invitation record. UUID v4 string, auto-generated when the invitation is created. Serves as the unique resource identifier for invitation detail retrieval and resolution operations.

email.description:
The email address of the invited person.

Serves as the matching key for automatic invitation resolution. When someone signs up with this email address, the invitation is automatically resolved and they become an employee of the organization.
email.x-autobe-specification: The email address the invitation was sent to. This is the matching key for automatic invitation resolution per [80]: when a new user signs up with this email address, the system scans for all pending invitations matching it across all organizations and automatically resolves each one, adding the user as an employee to every inviting organization with the role specified at invitation time per [126]. Must be a valid email format. If the email already belongs to an existing user account when the invitation is sent, the user is immediately added as an employee and no invitation record is persisted — so the email here always represents an address not yet registered in the system.

status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the invitation.

Three states exist: pending means the invitation is waiting for the recipient to create an account with the invited email address; fulfilled means the recipient has signed up and been automatically enrolled as an employee in the organization; revoked means the invitation was manually cancelled before the recipient could accept it, permanently terminating the invitation.
status.x-autobe-specification: Lifecycle status of the invitation with three allowed values per the invitation list API operation (PATCH /erpHrm/member/invitations). pending: the invitation has been sent to the email address but the recipient has not yet created an account with that email — the invitation remains open indefinitely awaiting sign-up. fulfilled: the recipient has signed up using the invited email address and has been automatically added to the organization as an employee with the role specified at invitation time. revoked: the invitation was manually cancelled by a user with the employee:manage permission before the recipient could accept it, permanently terminating the invitation. Note: invitations are only created for unknown email addresses per [80]; if the email already belongs to an existing user, the user is immediately added as an employee and no invitation record appears in this collection.

inviter.description:
The employee who sent this invitation.

Contains summary profile information about the inviter, including their name, role, and department within the organization.
inviter.x-autobe-specification: The employee who sent the invitation, surfaced as IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary. Implemented via JOIN: invitation's sender employee ID → erp_hrm_employees table → erp_hrm_members table, providing the inviter's display name, email, role, department, position, employment type, and status. The inviter must have held the employee:manage permission to send the invitation per [126].

created_at.description:
When the invitation was sent.

ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC representing the moment the invitation was created and dispatched to the recipient's email address.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Timestamp when the invitation record was created and sent to the recipient's email address. ISO 8601 date-time string in UTC. Set automatically on creation and never modified after. Used as the default sort key: invitations are listed in descending chronological order so the most recently sent invitations appear first.

IErpHrmInvitation.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an organization invitation.

Provides a lightweight view of an invitation sent to an external email address to join the organization. Each record displays the invited email address, the current lifecycle status, when the invitation was sent, and who sent it. Used in paginated invitation list responses where each entry provides essential identifying information without the full invitation details.

The status field indicates the invitation's current state: pending for invitations awaiting the recipient's sign-up, and resolved for invitations where the recipient has created an account and been automatically added to the organization as an employee.
IErpHrmInvitation.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Source: invitation records sent to external email addresses for organization enrollment. No single database table loaded — treat as a standalone conceptual entity. Direct fields: id (UUID primary key), email (invited recipient address used for sign-up matching per [80][126]), status (pending — awaiting sign-up; resolved — recipient has signed up and been automatically added to the organization as an employee per [107][113]), created_at (sent timestamp). Relation: inviter composed via JOIN through sender reference to erp_hrm_employees → erp_hrm_members, surfacing as IErpHrmEmployee.ISummary. Excluded from DTO: organization_id (session-scoped), updated_at, deleted_at (filtered at query level), sender FK column, resolved-user reference, HAS-MANY compositions. Sorting: by created_at DESC for most recent invitations first. Note: if the invited email already belongs to an existing user account when the invitation is sent, the user is immediately added as an employee and no invitation record is persisted — only invitations sent to unknown email addresses appear in this collection per [80].

total_budget_hours.description:
Sum of all budget hour estimates across every qualifying project in the report.

Sourced from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours for all projects matching the filter criteria. Represents the total planned or estimated work hours across the organization's budgeted projects.
total_budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours) across all projects in the current organization where deleted_at IS NULL AND budget_hours IS NOT NULL. Projects without budget_hours (NULL) are excluded from the sum.

total_actual_hours.description:
Sum of all actual logged hours across every qualifying project in the report.

Computed as the aggregate of per-project actual_hours, derived from SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) divided by 60. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs. Projects with no timelogs contribute zero to this total.
total_actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 across all timelogs whose project_id belongs to a qualifying project in the current organization. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs. If no timelogs exist for any qualifying project, the total is 0.

overall_utilization.description:
Overall utilization percentage computed as (total_actual_hours / total_budget_hours) × 100.

A value above 100% indicates the organization has logged more hours than budgeted across all projects. A value of 0% occurs when there are no qualifying projects (total_budget_hours is zero). This single metric provides a quick organizational health check on project time budget consumption.
overall_utilization.x-autobe-specification: (total_actual_hours / total_budget_hours) × 100. When total_budget_hours is 0 (no qualifying projects exist), return 0 to avoid division by zero. Result is a percentage value where values above 100 indicate budget overrun.

IErpHrmProjectBudgetReport.ISummary.description:
Organization-wide summary totals for the project budget report.

Provides aggregate figures across all included projects: total budget hours (sum of all project estimates), total actual hours (sum of all logged hours), and overall utilization percentage (actual divided by budget across the entire organization).

This summary gives leadership a single-number health check on how the organization's project time budgets are being consumed overall.
IErpHrmProjectBudgetReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification:
Computed totals aggregated across all qualifying projects in the report response.

total_budget_hours = SUM(erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours) across all projects meeting filter criteria: organization_id matches current session context, deleted_at IS NULL, budget_hours IS NOT NULL.

total_actual_hours = SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 across all timelogs linked to qualifying projects (via timelogs.project_id). Both billable and non-billable timelogs are included.

overall_utilization = (total_actual_hours / total_budget_hours) × 100. When total_budget_hours is 0 (no qualifying projects exist), overall_utilization must return 0 to avoid division by zero.

No individual timelog descriptions or employee-level details are exposed — strictly aggregate-only computation.

employee_id.description:
The unique identifier of the employee.

References the employee record within the organization. This UUID corresponds to an erp_hrm_employees row that is active (status = 'active') and not soft-deleted. The same employee may appear in multiple weeks' top-employee rankings.
employee_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct read from erp_hrm_employees.id within the current organization context. Filtered: erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id matches session-selected organization, deleted_at IS NULL on employee. Joined with timelogs for the total_hours aggregation.

display_name.description:
The employee's display name for human-readable identification.

Retrieved from the employee's associated member profile (erp_hrm_members.display_name). This is the name shown across the platform for the organization's member — consistent with how the employee appears in employee lists, project member views, and task assignments.
display_name.x-autobe-specification: JOIN erp_hrm_members ON erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_member_id = erp_hrm_members.id, selecting erp_hrm_members.display_name. Both tables filtered for deleted_at IS NULL. Organization scope is enforced via the employee record (erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id).

total_hours.description:
The total work hours logged by this employee during the current calendar week (Monday–Sunday).

Aggregated from all billable and non-billable timelog entries within the current week, converted from minutes to hours and rounded to two decimal places. A value of zero indicates the employee has not logged any time this week.

Used to rank employees for the top-5 dashboard widget. When no timelogs exist for any employee during the week, the entire top-employees array is empty rather than returning zero-hour entries.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where date falls within the current Monday–Sunday week (computed server-side using the organization's configured timezone), deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs, and the owning employee matches organization scope via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees. Result rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs.

IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.ITopEmploye.description:
A top employee ranked by total hours logged during the current calendar week.

Represents one of the five employees with the highest aggregated work hours for the week within the currently selected organization. The total hours reflect the sum of all billable and non-billable timelog durations, converted from minutes to hours with two-decimal precision.

This entry is part of the organization dashboard's top-employees metric, surfaced to managers and owners who hold the report:view permission. The ranking is recalculated on each request against live timelog data.
IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.ITopEmploye.x-autobe-specification:
Aggregated computation spanning three tables within the current organization context. Each row represents one of the top 5 employees ranked by total hours logged during the current calendar week (Monday–Sunday).

1. **employee_id**: Direct read from erp_hrm_employees.id. Filtered: erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_organization_id matches session-selected organization, deleted_at IS NULL on employee.

2. **display_name**: JOIN erp_hrm_members ON erp_hrm_employees.erp_hrm_member_id = erp_hrm_members.id, selecting erp_hrm_members.display_name. Both tables filtered for deleted_at IS NULL, organization scope via employee.

3. **total_hours**: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where date falls within the current Monday–Sunday week (computed server-side using the organization's configured timezone), deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs, and the owning employee matches organization scope via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees.

Overall: GROUP BY employee_id, display_name. ORDER BY total_hours DESC, LIMIT 5. If no timelogs exist for the week, return an empty array — never null fields. Each row must satisfy: employee_id is non-null UUID string, display_name is non-null string, total_hours is non-null number ≥ 0 rounded to 2 decimal places.

group_by.description:
Discriminator field identifying this report group variant.

When set to `employee`, the report entry represents an employee-grouped aggregation. This value is constant for all entries of this variant type and is used by clients to distinguish between employee, project, and task group types in the time report response.
group_by.x-autobe-specification:
Discriminator constant identifying this as the employee-grouped variant of the time report.

Always 'employee'. Used by clients to distinguish this variant from project-grouped and task-grouped entries in the union response.

employee_id.description:
Unique identifier of the employee whose time entries are aggregated in this report group.

The employee ID corresponds to the `erp_hrm_employees.id` record and is the primary grouping key for this report variant. All aggregated hour values and entry counts in this group belong to a single employee.
employee_id.x-autobe-specification:
Sourced from erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id — the UUID of the employee who logged the time entries being aggregated.

Used as the GROUP BY key for the aggregation query. Each unique employee_id within the filtered date range and organization scope produces one report group entry.

employee_name.description:
Display name of the employee whose time entries are aggregated in this report group.

The name is obtained from the employee's linked member profile and provides a human-readable identity for report consumers. This field eliminates the need for clients to perform additional lookups when displaying the report.
employee_name.x-autobe-specification:
Derived through a JOIN chain: erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id → erp_hrm_employees.id → erp_hrm_employees.member (relation to erp_hrm_members) → erp_hrm_members.display_name.

Provides the human-readable identity of the employee for report display purposes. Note: erp_hrm_employees does NOT have a display_name column — the display name lives on erp_hrm_members and must be accessed through the member relation.

total_hours.description:
Total hours worked by the employee within the requested date range.

This is the sum of all timelog durations (both billable and non-billable) converted from minutes to hours. The value is rounded to two decimal places and represents the employee's complete logged work time for the reporting period.

Deleted timelogs are excluded from this total.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification:
Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for all non-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL) belonging to this employee within the requested date range and organization scope.

Rounded to two decimal places.

billable_hours.description:
Billable hours worked by the employee within the requested date range.

This is the sum of all timelog durations where the `billable` flag is set to true, converted from minutes to hours. Billable hours represent client-chargeable work and are used in project budget reports and invoicing calculations.

The value is rounded to two decimal places. Deleted timelogs are excluded from this total.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification:
Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 filtered by billable = true for all non-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL) belonging to this employee within the requested date range and organization scope.

Rounded to two decimal places.

non_billable_hours.description:
Non-billable hours worked by the employee within the requested date range.

This is the sum of all timelog durations where the `billable` flag is set to false, converted from minutes to hours. Non-billable hours represent internal work such as meetings, training, and administrative tasks that are not charged to clients.

The value is rounded to two decimal places. Deleted timelogs are excluded from this total.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification:
Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 filtered by billable = false for all non-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL) belonging to this employee within the requested date range and organization scope.

Rounded to two decimal places.

entry_count.description:
Total number of timelog entries the employee recorded within the requested date range.

This count represents the raw number of individual time entries, regardless of their duration. It provides context for the hour totals — for example, an employee with 40 total hours from 5 entries averaged 8-hour sessions, while 40 hours from 20 entries indicates shorter, more fragmented work sessions.

Deleted timelogs are excluded from this count.
entry_count.x-autobe-specification:
Computed as COUNT(*) of all non-deleted erp_hrm_timelogs records (deleted_at IS NULL) belonging to this employee within the requested date range and organization scope.

A raw count — not affected by duration values.

IErpHrmTimeReport.IEmployeeGroup.description:
An aggregated time report entry grouped by employee, containing the employee's identifier, display name, and total hours worked broken down by billable status.

The employee group variant is returned when the time report's `groupBy` parameter is set to `employee`. Each entry represents one employee's aggregated work hours within the requested date range.

Hour values are rounded to two decimal places. Individual timelog descriptions and personal notes are not included — only aggregated numerical data and the employee's identifying information are exposed.

Deleted timelogs are excluded from all aggregations.
IErpHrmTimeReport.IEmployeeGroup.x-autobe-specification:
Computed report group from erp_hrm_timelogs aggregated by employee_id with a JOIN to erp_hrm_employees, then through the member relation to erp_hrm_members for the employee's display name.

**Discriminator**: group_by = 'employee' (constant).

**Identifier fields**:
- employee_id: sourced from erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id (UUID) — the GROUP BY key
- employee_name: derived from erp_hrm_employees.member (relation to erp_hrm_members) → erp_hrm_members.display_name

**Aggregation formulas** (all sourced from erp_hrm_timelogs):
- total_hours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60
- billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable = true) / 60
- non_billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable = false) / 60
- entry_count = COUNT(*)

**Constraints**: Aggregation scoped by date range and organization context (via employee's erp_hrm_organization_id). Hour values rounded to two decimal places. Only non-deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NULL) are included in aggregations.

project_id.description:
Unique identifier of the project.

Primary key of the project in the erp_hrm_projects table. Scoped to the currently selected organization through the session's active organization context.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.id column. Filtered: organization_id matches session-selected organization, deleted_at IS NULL.

project_name.description:
Display name of the project.

The human-readable name assigned at project creation. Used to identify the project in dashboard budget-overview sections and reports.
project_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.name column. Same organization scope and soft-delete filter (deleted_at IS NULL) as project_id.

budget_hours.description:
The planned budget hours allocated to the project.

Defined when the project is created or updated. Represents the total number of work hours expected for project completion. Only projects with a defined (non-null) budget are evaluated for the over-budget metric; projects without a budget are excluded.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours column. Only projects with non-null budget_hours are evaluated. Same organization scope and soft-delete filters.

actual_hours.description:
The total actual hours logged against the project through timelogs.

Aggregated from all non-deleted timelog entries associated with this project within the current organization, converted from minutes to hours with two-decimal precision. Includes both billable and non-billable time entries from all employees who have logged time to the project.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id matches the project and deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs. Owning employee must match organization scope via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees (organization_id matches session). Round to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable time entries from all employees who have logged time to the project.

IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.IProjectOve.description:
A project whose actual logged hours exceed 80% of its planned budget hours.

Represents one project from the organization dashboard's budget-overview section, surfaced to managers and owners who hold the report:view permission. Each entry pairs the project's planned budget with the total actual hours logged through timelogs, enabling rapid identification of projects at risk of exceeding their allocated time budget.

Projects are ordered by utilization percentage (actual / budget) descending, so the most over-budget project appears first. Only projects with a defined budget are evaluated; projects without a budget are excluded from this metric.
IErpHrmOrganizationDashboard.IProjectOve.x-autobe-specification:
Computed type aggregating data from erp_hrm_projects and erp_hrm_timelogs within the current organization context.

1. **project_id**: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.id. Filtered: organization_id matches session-selected organization, deleted_at IS NULL.

2. **project_name**: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.name. Same organization scope and soft-delete filter as project_id.

3. **budget_hours**: Direct read from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours. Only projects with non-null budget_hours are evaluated. Same organization and soft-delete filters.

4. **actual_hours**: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 for timelogs where erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id matches the project and deleted_at IS NULL on timelogs and their owning employees (via JOIN to erp_hrm_employees filtered by organization scope). Round to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable time entries.

Overall filter: actual_hours / budget_hours > 0.80. Order by utilization percentage descending. Return empty array — never null — when no projects exceed the threshold.

project_id.description:
Unique identifier of the project.

Corresponds to the project's primary key in erp_hrm_projects. Used to uniquely identify each project row within the budget report.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.id. UUID primary key of the project, serving as the unique row identifier in this report. Always present for every project with a defined budget.

project_name.description:
Display name of the project.

Sourced from erp_hrm_projects.name. This is the human-readable project identifier shown in project lists, timelog entry forms, timesheet summaries, and reports.
project_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.name. Display name of the project, used for human-readable identification in report rows.

budget_hours.description:
Total estimated hours budgeted for the project.

Sourced from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours. Projects without a defined budget are excluded from the report entirely. This value serves as the baseline for calculating the utilization percentage.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours (DoublePrecision). Only projects with a non-null budget value appear in the report. This value serves as the denominator for computing utilization_percentage.

actual_hours.description:
Total hours actually logged against this project across all employees.

Computed as the sum of all timelog duration_minutes divided by 60, including both billable and non-billable entries. Projects with no timelogs logged return zero.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0, grouped by project_id via LEFT JOIN. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs where deleted_at IS NULL. Defaults to 0 for projects that have no associated timelogs.

utilization_percentage.description:
Percentage of budget hours consumed by actual logged hours.

Computed as (actual_hours / budget_hours) × 100. A value above 100 indicates the project is over budget, while a low percentage suggests under-utilization relative to the planned budget. Projects with no timelogs return zero percent.
utilization_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed as (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100.0. Defaults to 0 when actual_hours is 0. No upper bound — values above 100 indicate the project has exceeded its budgeted hours.

project_status.description:
Current lifecycle status of the project.

One of three possible values: active (accepting new time entries and timelogs), archived (preserved but frozen — no new time entries accepted), or completed (finished and frozen — no new time entries accepted). Sourced from erp_hrm_projects.status.
project_status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from erp_hrm_projects.status. One of three lifecycle values: active (accepting new time entries), archived (preserved but frozen), or completed (finished and frozen). All statuses are included in the report.

IErpHrmProjectBudgetReport.IItem.description:
Per-project budget comparison item showing estimated budget hours versus actual logged hours for a single project.

Each item represents one project that has a defined budget, regardless of its lifecycle status (active, archived, or completed). The utilization percentage is computed as actual hours divided by budget hours, helping managers quickly identify over-budget or under-utilized projects.

Projects with no timelogs logged still appear with zero actual hours and zero percent utilization, ensuring the full budget picture is visible. Both billable and non-billable timelogs are included in the actual hours calculation. No individual timelog descriptions or employee-level details are exposed.
IErpHrmProjectBudgetReport.IItem.x-autobe-specification:
Cross-table aggregation sourced from erp_hrm_projects and erp_hrm_timelogs via LEFT JOIN on project_id, filtered to the current organization context.

Source query:
- FROM erp_hrm_projects (filtered: organization_id = current context, deleted_at IS NULL, budget_hours IS NOT NULL)
- LEFT JOIN erp_hrm_timelogs (filtered: deleted_at IS NULL) ON timelogs.project_id = projects.id

Field computations:
- project_id: erp_hrm_projects.id (UUID string)
- project_name: erp_hrm_projects.name (string)
- budget_hours: erp_hrm_projects.budget_hours (DoublePrecision → number)
- actual_hours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0, grouped by project_id. Includes both billable and non-billable timelogs. Defaults to 0 for projects with no timelogs.
- utilization_percentage: (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100.0. Defaults to 0 when actual_hours is 0.
- project_status: erp_hrm_projects.status (string, one of: active, archived, completed)

Aggregation only — no individual timelog descriptions, employee-level data, or task-level detail exposed. Each row represents exactly one project that has a defined budget.

group_by.description:
Discriminator constant identifying this as a project-grouped report entry.

Always set to the string `"project"` to distinguish this variant from other grouping options (employee, task) within the time report's polymorphic data array.
group_by.x-autobe-specification: Constant discriminator value 'project' identifying this variant within the IErpHrmTimeReport.data[] oneOf union. Not sourced from any database column — set by the query builder based on the groupBy parameter.

project_id.description:
Unique identifier of the project for this aggregated time report entry.

This UUID corresponds to the project against which all timelogs in this entry were logged. Use this identifier to fetch full project details from the projects endpoint if needed.
project_id.x-autobe-specification: Grouping key from erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id via GROUP BY clause. Represents the project identifier used to aggregate all timelogs for this report entry. Format: UUID.

project_name.description:

non_billable_hours.description:
Aggregated non-billable work hours for this task group.

Computed from timelogs where billable is false. Represents internal or administrative work not charged to clients. Rounded to two decimal places.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = false THEN erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2). Only timelogs where billable is false contribute. Deleted timelogs are excluded.

entry_count.description:
Number of individual timelog entries aggregated into this task group.

entry_count.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT(*) of erp_hrm_timelogs records in the group. Each individual timelog row contributes 1 to this count regardless of its duration. Deleted timelogs are excluded. Distinct timelogs counted — not distinct dates, employees, or any other grouping.

IErpHrmTimeReport.ITaskGroup.description:
A task-grouped entry in the aggregated time report, summarizing logged work hours for a specific task or unassigned timelogs within the organization.

When the time report is grouped by task, each entry represents all timelogs associated with a single task — or the collective unassigned timelogs not linked to any task. Hour totals distinguish billable from non-billable work, and the entry count indicates how many individual timelog records were aggregated.

A null taskId with the title "Unassigned" identifies the synthetic group for timelogs that have no task assignment, ensuring complete coverage of all logged hours in the reporting period.
IErpHrmTimeReport.ITaskGroup.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregation variant for the time report when grouped by task.

**Data Sources**:
- erp_hrm_timelogs (primary source: duration_minutes, billable, task_id, deleted_at)
- erp_hrm_tasks (joined via task_id: id, title)

All data scoped to the member's active organization via employee → organization chain. Deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) are excluded from all aggregations.

**Discriminator**: group_by = 'task' (const).

**Aggregation Pipeline**:
1. Filter erp_hrm_timelogs by organization scope, date range, and deleted_at IS NULL.
2. LEFT JOIN erp_hrm_tasks ON erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id = erp_hrm_tasks.id.
3. GROUP BY erp_hrm_timelogs.task_id (a null grouping key forms the "Unassigned" synthetic group).
4. Compute per-group aggregates:
   - entry_count = COUNT(*)
   - total_hours = ROUND(SUM(duration_minutes) / 60.0, 2)
   - billable_hours = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN billable = true THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2)
   - non_billable_hours = ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN billable = false THEN duration_minutes ELSE 0 END) / 60.0, 2)
5. Populate taskId from joined erp_hrm_tasks.id, or null for the null-keyed group.
6. Populate title from joined erp_hrm_tasks.title, or the literal string 'Unassigned' for the null-keyed group.

**Edge Cases**:
- Timelogs with null task_id produce a synthetic group with taskId: null and title: 'Unassigned'.
- Groups with zero matching timelogs may still appear with all metrics at zero.
- Deleted timelogs (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) are excluded from aggregation.

weekStartDate.description:

Represents the first day (Monday) of the ISO 8601 week that this aggregation covers. Derived from the timelog dates that fall within this week.
weekStartDate.x-autobe-specification: Derived from the ISO week grouping of erp_hrm_timelogs.date. Set to the Monday date of the grouped ISO week. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

weekEndDate.description:

Represents the last day (Sunday) of the ISO 8601 week that this aggregation covers.
weekEndDate.x-autobe-specification: Computed as weekStartDate + 6 days (Sunday of the same ISO week). Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations (in minutes) divided by 60. Includes both billable and non-billable time from all employees with timelogs in the week.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 across all timelogs whose date falls within this ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

billableHours.description:
Total billable hours logged in this week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

Computed as the sum of durations for timelogs marked as billable within the week. Represents client-chargeable or revenue-generating work time.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true across all timelogs in this ISO week, rounded to 2 decimal places.

nonBillableHours.description:

Computed as totalHours minus billableHours. Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as totalHours − billableHours. Represents timelogs where erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = false. Rounded to 2 decimal places.

totalTimelogs.description:

A simple count of all timelog entries that fall within the Monday-to-Sunday date range, regardless of duration, billable status, or employee.

Each entry summarizes time spent on one project during the week. Projects with no timelogs in the week are omitted from the array.

For each project: compute totalHours (SUM(duration_minutes) / 60), billableHours (SUM WHERE billable = true / 60), timelogCount (COUNT). Join erp_hrm_projects to retrieve projectName. Projects with zero timelogs in the week are omitted from the array.

Per-employee breakdown of hours and timelog counts for this week.

Each entry summarizes one employee's total logged time during the week. Employees with no timelogs in the week are omitted. Includes deactivated employees' historical data for complete reporting accuracy.
employeeBreakdown.x-autobe-specification: GROUP BY erp_hrm_timelogs.employee_id across all timelogs in this ISO week. For each employee: compute totalHours (SUM(duration_minutes) / 60), billableHours (SUM WHERE billable = true / 60), timelogCount (COUNT). Join erp_hrm_employees and erp_hrm_members to retrieve employeeName. Employees with zero timelogs in the week are omitted. Includes deactivated employees' historical data.

IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IWeek.description:
A single ISO week entry in the weekly summary report, aggregating all timelogs within a Monday-to-Sunday period.

Contains the week's date range, total hours (with billable vs non-billable split), total timelog count, and per-project and per-employee breakdowns. All hour values are rounded to 2 decimal places.
IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IWeek.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate type representing one ISO week (Monday–Sunday) of time tracking data across the organization.

Source tables: erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes, billable, date), erp_hrm_employees (id, name via erp_hrm_members), erp_hrm_projects (id, name).

Computation per week:
- weekStartDate: Monday of the ISO week derived from GROUP BY on timelog dates
- weekEndDate: Sunday of the ISO week (weekStartDate + 6 days)
- totalHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places
- billableHours: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places

- employeeBreakdown: GROUP BY employee_id; compute per-employee totalHours, billableHours, timelogCount; join erp_hrm_employees and erp_hrm_members for employeeName. Employees with zero timelogs are omitted. Deactivated employees' historical data is included.

totalHours.description:
Total hours logged against this project during the week.

Computed as the sum of all timelog durations in minutes divided by 60, rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes both billable and non-billable time, providing a complete view of all work performed on the project during the week.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places. Aggregates all timelog durations for the project within the ISO week regardless of billable status. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

billableHours.description:
Total billable hours logged against this project during the week.

Subset of totalHours representing client-chargeable or revenue-generating work time. Rounded to 2 decimal places for consistency with other hour values in the report.
billableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE erp_hrm_timelogs.billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places. Subset of totalHours representing client-chargeable work. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

nonBillableHours.description:
Total non-billable hours logged against this project during the week.

Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time. Computed as the difference between totalHours and billableHours, ensuring the two categories always sum to the total.
nonBillableHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed as totalHours − billableHours, rounded to 2 decimal places. Represents internal work, administrative tasks, or other non-client-chargeable time. Derived arithmetically rather than via a separate database query for consistency.

timelogCount.description:
Number of individual timelog records for this project within the week.

A simple count of all timelog entries regardless of duration or billable status. Provides visibility into how many separate time entries make up the total hours.
timelogCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed as COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this project within the ISO week. A simple row count regardless of duration or billable status. Scoped to the member's selected organization.

IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IProjectBreak.description:
Per-project breakdown of hours and timelog counts within a single ISO week.

Summarizes all time logged against one project during the Monday-to-Sunday week period. Includes the project identifier and display name, total hours with a billable/non-billable split, and the count of individual timelog records.

All hour values are rounded to 2 decimal places for precision and consistency.
IErpHrmWeeklySummaryReport.IProjectBreak.x-autobe-specification:
Computed aggregate type representing time tracking data for one project within an ISO week.

Source tables: erp_hrm_timelogs (duration_minutes, billable, date, project_id), erp_hrm_projects (id, name).

Computation per project within the week:
- projectId: erp_hrm_timelogs.project_id from the GROUP BY key
- projectName: erp_hrm_projects.name via JOIN on project_id
- totalHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60, rounded to 2 decimal places
- billableHours: SUM(erp_hrm_timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60 WHERE billable = true, rounded to 2 decimal places
- nonBillableHours: totalHours − billableHours, rounded to 2 decimal places
- timelogCount: COUNT of erp_hrm_timelogs records for this project in the ISO week

Data isolation: Scoped to the member's currently selected organization via erp_hrm_timelogs → erp_hrm_employees.organization_id. Only projects with at least one timelog in the week are included.
